newsitem.title: UK: FORECAST - Swiss stocks seen tracking sober rises.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Swiss stocks seen tracking sober rises.

text.p: Swiss stocks are expected to perform better than earlier expectations with steady, if unspectacular, rises until the end of the year, according to a Reuters survey of equity index forecasts.
The six analysts made an average forecast for a rise in the blue-chip Swiss Market Index (SMI) to 4,832.5 by the end of the year, compared with a March 13 close of 4,673.9.
The year-end mean prediction of seven analysts for the Swiss Performance Index (SPI) was 3,055, compared with a close of 2,954.45 on March 13.

The forecasts were considerably more bullish than predictions made in the Reuters equities index poll three months ago, when the SMI and SPI were tipped to hit 4,155 and 2,676 respectively by the end of the year.
Analysts cautioned that Swiss stocks could be in for a correction following recent all-time closing highs of 4,734.10 and 2,985.28 for the two indices, before the market returned to its upward trend.
HANS-PETER AST, HEAD OF BROKER RESEARCH, UNION BANK OF SWITZERLAND (UBS):
"At this level, the market is no longer cheap and corrections cannot be excluded.
